integrity.evidence_scope: Actual checker enumerates 158 homology/acyclicity cases and 576 exact signed-Lefschetz comparisons; separate proof covers all parameters.

scientific_limitations: At least three spider arms; each arm length at least three edges; integer r at least the longest arm length.
The integral equivariant statement concerns homology modules, not an equivariant wedge splitting.
The nonempty longer-arm theorem has not undergone independent validation; an equivalent unindexed treatment remains possible.
title: Stable higher-independence topology and integral symmetries of long-arm spider trees
